title: Blue-Green Deployment
summary: We reduce downtime by maintaining two identical environments and switching traffic after validation.

content.overview: We deploy new releases to a green environment while blue continues serving production, then switch traffic after testing, allowing instant rollback.
content.details: Process: 1. Blue environment serves production traffic; 2. Deploy new version to green environment; 3. Test green environment; 4. Switch traffic from blue to green; 5. Keep blue as rollback option.
